# CASMI Spectrum Model v1

## Overview

Pretrained neural-network model artifacts developed for the **Enveda CASMI 2026 – Molecule ID From Mass Spectra** Kaggle competition.

The release supports computational mass spectrometry workflows, including learning molecular information from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) and supporting candidate molecular structure identification.

The dataset provides model checkpoints and associated training resources for reuse in experimental inference, molecular ranking, and ensemble pipelines.

## Intended Use

- Molecular structure identification from tandem mass spectra.
- Model inference and experimental candidate ranking.
- Integration into ensemble or reranking pipelines.
- Reproducibility research and comparison of mass-spectrum modeling approaches.
- Participation in Enveda CASMI 2026, subject to competition rules.

## Model Artifacts

The release contains pretrained PyTorch checkpoints (`.pt`) and supporting training artifacts.

The associated configuration and preprocessing resources document the model setup and expected input representations. Consult the actual checkpoint and configuration files for architecture-specific details.

## Preprocessing and Input Schema

The competition's molecular structure data includes the `normalized_smiles` field.

An earlier `prepare.py` implementation accepted `smiles` and `canonical_smiles`, but did not recognize `normalized_smiles`. Supporting `normalized_smiles` as an additional SMILES input alias resolves this schema compatibility issue.

This compatibility correction should not be interpreted as independently verified reproduction of the released checkpoint.

The published `.pt` files are pretrained artifacts. Exact training-run provenance should be distinguished from compatibility changes to preprocessing scripts.

## License

**Apache License 2.0**

The original PyTorch checkpoints, author-created training scripts, configurations, and supporting artifacts distributed in this release are licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

This permits use, modification, distribution, and inference, including use in CASMI 2026 submissions, provided applicable competition rules are followed.

Third-party dependencies, datasets, and any externally sourced components remain subject to their respective licenses.

Full license: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

## Limitations

- Model outputs are predictions and should not be treated as definitive chemical structure identifications.
- Performance may vary across molecular classes, experimental conditions, collision energies, and ionization modes.
- Competition performance does not necessarily generalize to independent experimental datasets.
- The release does not guarantee exact training reproducibility without the corresponding original producer revision and training-run records.

## Attribution

Developed and published by Saner Turhaner (kaggle.com/sanpier) for research and experimentation in the Enveda CASMI 2026 competition.
